gaps: FY2007-FY2022: no published financials (company founded 2021, private until the 2026 S-1; the S-1 presents audited results only for FY2023-FY2025)
FY2023 totalAssets, totalEquity, cashAndEquivalents, totalDebt, sharesOutstanding: the S-1 balance sheets are dated 2024-12-31, 2025-12-31 and 2026-06-30 only
FY2023-FY2025 employees: the S-1 gives headcount only as of 2026-09-30 (approximately 5,300)
notes: Pre-IPO: S-1 filed on SEC EDGAR 2026-10-26 (CIK 2130357, accession 0001628280-26-067168), proposed Nasdaq symbol ANT; no market price yet, so no Yahoo cross-check
Net loss is dominated by non-cash fair-value changes on convertible notes, derivatives and SAFEs: -1,045M (2023), -5,434M (2024), -34,308M (2025); operating loss is the cleaner operating measure
FY2025 operating expenses include a 1,500M Bartz copyright settlement
totalDebt = convertible notes payable carried at fair value (no other borrowings on the balance sheet; operating lease liabilities excluded)
totalEquity = total stockholders' deficit; redeemable convertible preferred stock (2,874M at 2024, 29,769M at 2025) sits in mezzanine and is excluded
sharesOutstanding = Class A common issued and outstanding; no Class N or Class T shares were outstanding at either year-end; dilutedEPS equals basic (loss years)
Never declared or paid a dividend (S-1 dividend policy), so dividendPerShare = 0

Six months ended 2026-06-30 (unaudited, F-8/F-13): revenue 16,286M, operating loss -693M, net loss -80,748M, operating cash flow +3,929M, capex -482M; balance sheet at 2026-06-30: total assets 147,358M, cash 112,389M, convertible notes 108,566M, stockholders' deficit -127,619M
